description: Data masking is not used according to access control policy and business requirements.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not implement data masking, redaction, or obfuscation techniques to protect sensitive information in non-production environments, displays, reports, or for users without need-to-know access.

metadata.detection_notes: Review data masking implementations in test/development environments, production databases, application displays, reporting systems, and compliance with privacy requirements for handling PII, PHI, or payment card data.
